title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E5 — Free at Last
When Vanessa is not given the promotion she was promised, she takes Mark's advice to demand her rights and is promptly discharged from her job.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E6 — Father Fairest
When Earvin tells Mark that his greatest wish is to see his long-lost father, Mark locates Earvin's dad and invites him to the Halloween dance with nearly disastrous results.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E7 — The Goodbye Girl
Mark persuades Geneva to use "reverse psychology" on the rebellious Nicole, and they let her do anything she wants to teach her that rules are important. Vanessa pretends to like sports to impress a man.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E8 — Isn’t She Lovely?
Hakeem and Moesha’s friendship takes an interesting turn after he surprises her with an expensive necklace to wear to a homecoming dance she’s attending with someone else.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E9 — Unappreciated Interest
Dorian pulls an illegal scam involving Frank’s credit card and makes matters worse by lying about it, behavior that could have dramatic consequences.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E10 — Thanksgiving
With Dee sick in bed with a bad cold, Moesha offers to prepare the Thanksgiving feast but finds herself engaged in a fierce cooking competition with Hakeem’s mother.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E11 — To Sleep, Perchance To Dream
Moesha starts having recurring romantic dreams about Hakeem, giving her second thoughts about their friendship and about sharing a room with him and Niecy on an upcoming ski trip.

Michael takes living life to its fullest a little too far.

description:
S2 E1 — Mom's Away (Part 1)

title: My Wife and Kids

title: Half & Half
description:
S2 E18 — The Big Good Help Is Hard To Fire Episode
Mona discovers that her new vice president title comes with new, sometimes unpleasant, responsibilities as she's forced to fire her friend and assistant Adam at the request of her boss Kai.

title: Half & Half
description:
S2 E19 — The Big Practice What You Preach
Using her womanly charm and baking skill, Phyllis competes with another female parishioner for the heart of the single and handsome Pastor Adams (guest star Clifton Davis), who is christening Big Dee Dee's new baby boy, Drew.

title: Half & Half
description:
S2 E20 — The Big Employee Benefits Episode
When Dee Dee and her law school rival vie for the same internship at a prestigious firm, Dee Dee resorts to dressing provocatively to gain a competitive edge and impress her potential new boss.
